findings.title: Missing await on async fetch_rate call
findings.body: `fetch_rate` is an async function, but line 17 calls it without `await`, so the function returns a coroutine object instead of the rate. This will raise a `TypeError` when the multiplication is attempted. Add `await` before `fetch_rate(pair)`.

findings.title: Rounding a Decimal multiplication result to int
findings.body: The function multiplies `amount_cents` (an `int`) by `rate` (a `Decimal`) and then rounds to an `int`. This can lose precision and may not match the expected rounding behavior for financial calculations. Consider rounding to a fixed number of decimal places or using `Decimal` throughout.

summary.problem: The new `converted_cents` function is missing an `await` on the async `fetch_rate` call and rounds a Decimal multiplication to int, risking precision loss.
summary.done_well: The function is clearly documented and uses a dedicated helper for rate fetching.
